observations: The launcher started the dedicated isolated Media preview and local preview services, then Tailscale reported that Serve is not enabled for this tailnet.
The launcher was interrupted after the activation notice; its API/World/web preview processes and dedicated Media container were stopped and verified absent.
Existing local API, World, Media, database, Redis, Prometheus, and the localhost:5173 web listener remained available and healthy.
requiredExternalAction: A tailnet administrator must enable Serve for this device before the HTTPS preview can be started.
